text: dsh-macos-tap-fix 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 macOS 点击修复插件。它在浏览器侧监听鼠标按下和抬起事件；当输入法场景下出现抬起先于按下、导致触控板轻点点击丢失时，短暂等待原生 click，若未出现便在原目标上补发点击，并忽略迟到的按下事件。适合使用 macOS、输入法和 Tap-to-Click 的 DSH 用户。通过 profile bundle 安装并重启后生效；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-macos-tap-fix fixes lost trackpad taps in DSH on macOS. Its browser code detects mouseup before mousedown, waits 40 ms for a native click, and clicks the original target if none arrives. Add it to the profile bundle and restart. It uses no API key or external service.
macOS 输入法开着时，触控板轻点按钮经常第一次没反应，能修复吗？
让 DSH 在 Mac 上正确处理 Tap-to-Click 丢失的第一次点击。
DSH 聊天输入框聚焦后，点按钮要点两次才能触发，怎么办？
dsh-macos-tap-fix 的功能「补回丢失的轻点」：检测异常鼠标事件顺序后等待 40 毫秒；若未收到原生 click，就对仍在页面中的原目标补发点击。仅在 macOS 处理左键。

dsh-macos-tap-fix README · dsh-macos-tap-fix：A small workaround plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh / dsh-tauri) on macOS.

> **Temporary.** Remove it once the WebKit fix ships.

dsh-macos-tap-fix README · Symptom：On macOS, with an input method (e.g. Japanese, Chinese) active and an editable element focused (such as the chat input), the first **Tap-to-Click** on a button does nothing; a second tap is needed. Pressing the trackpad down, or using Firefox, works.

dsh-macos-tap-fix README · Cause：WebKit Bug [219670](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=219670): the tap's `mouseup` can be delivered **before** its `mousedown`, so the `click` is lost. A fix is proposed in [WebKit/WebKit#76581](https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/pull/76581). It affects Safari and WKWebView apps, including dsh-tauri.

dsh-macos-tap-fix README · What this plugin does：Browser-side only, macOS only. When a `mouseup` arrives with no preceding `mousedown`, it waits 40 ms; if no `click` reached that element, it dispatches one, and ignores the late `mousedown`. Normal clicks are untouched.

dsh-macos-tap-fix README · Install：In your dsh profile's `package.json`, add the dependency and the bundle, then restart the app:

```json
"dependencies": { "dsh-macos-tap-fix": "github:lifwsp/dsh-macos-tap-fix" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-macos-tap-fix"] } }
```

To remove: delete both entries and restart.

dsh-macos-tap-fix README · Caveats：- It infers broken event order and synthesizes a click, so edge cases are possible. Use at your own risk.
- Only verified by hand on macOS 26.5.1 with Google Japanese Input.
- Plugins reload only after restarting the app.
